key_insight: A deterministic multi-agent AI framework can reduce premature diagnostic handoff and catch silent hallucinations by enforcing symptom-completeness checks and uncertainty gating.
clinical_relevance: For healthcare chatbots, the approach aims to make diagnostic support more reliable by requiring structured history collection before recommendations are released.
method: Enforces OLDCARTS completeness with a neuro-symbolic state-tracking gate.
Uses semantic entropy across 5 independent diagnostic samples to flag divergent or uncertain outputs.
Replaces LLM-as-a-judge routing with deterministic orchestration constraints.
evidence_signal: In 150 simulated test cases, the full system reached 49.3% diagnostic precision, an 11.3-point absolute gain over the unconstrained baseline, with a negative correlation between OLDCARTS completeness and semantic entropy (r = -0.181, p < 0.05).
watch_item: Results come from simulated patient interactions, so real-world clinical performance, safety, and workflow integration still need validation.
paper_title: Agentic AI-based Framework for Mitigating Premature Diagnostic Handoff and Silent Hallucination in Healthcare Applications
